bugs.error_message: Raw CSS (site-footer and compare-grid rules) displayed as visible text at the top of Patho_Week6_Interactive_Guide.html
bugs.root_cause: The guide was assembled by concatenating a head slice of the Week 2 guide with new body files. The head slice ended with </style>, and the new body file began with additional CSS rules, so those rules landed outside the stylesheet and the browser rendered them as page text.
bugs.fix: Removed the stray </style> at the seam so the appended CSS sits inside the single <style> block. Verified with a parser check: exactly one <style>/</style> pair, no CSS after the closing tag.
